approvalSource: explicit user approval in conversation to establish journal.ekodi.kr as the EKODI common journal service, followed by the instruction to build it
summary: Register journal.ekodi.kr as a justified common-service boundary for public editorial records, feeds and reusable journal publishing contracts while preserving ekodi.kr path namespaces for user-operated journals.
boundaryReason: independently operated common journal service with its own release, cache, feed and editorial contract; it does not represent a person, organization, group or project identity
workspaceRule: tenant and user journal surfaces remain canonical under ekodi.kr personal, org, group or project paths and resolve authority from workspace_id
migrationPolicy: additive; no existing domain, route, identity or workspace address is removed or reassigned
verificationPolicy: constitution, platform-boundary, security, isolated journal tests, guarded deploy and real-host verification must pass
rollbackPlan: remove the journal Worker route and service registration, revert constitution 1.2.0 registration to 1.1.0, and keep all existing workspace paths and services unchanged
